sql.main: SELECT t1.thanh_pho AS "city", SUM(t0.tong_tien) AS "revenue" FROM silver.don_hang AS t0 JOIN silver.chi_nhanh AS t1 ON t0.co_so_ma = t1.ma_chi_nhanh WHERE (t1.thanh_pho IN ('Hồ Chí Minh', 'Đà Nẵng')) AND (t0.trang_thai_don_hang IN ('HOAN_THANH', 'DANG_GIAO')) AND (t0.ngay_tao >= DATE '2026-09-01') AND (t0.ngay_tao < DATE '2026-10-01') GROUP BY t1.thanh_pho ORDER BY "city" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50001
